nodes.label: Currency Derived From Country
nodes.rationale: Removes inconsistent rows (e.g. Indian employee paid in EUR by typo); a currency column can be added later and backfilled.

nodes.label: Fixed Dated FX Rate Table (domain/currency.py)
nodes.rationale: Conversion applied at read time so updating the rate table re-bases every report; fixed rates give stable reporting vs live rates.

nodes.label: Insights Aggregation in Python
nodes.rationale: SQLite lacks percentile_cont; one code path keeps SQLite tests covering prod behaviour. ~20ms at 10k, ~300ms at 100k; revisit past 50-100k rows via DB percentiles or materialised views behind the same service interface.
